Employee view: this is all a member of staff sees

● Company setup

Set up this client's company profile. These details identify the business across the system and feed the report headers. Everything here is saved to this client.
This screen builds the client's risk picture. It lists the things in the business that could seriously hurt someone, scores how big each risk is, and plans the work that brings it under control. Complete it top to bottom: answer the discovery questions with the client, add the risks (from the library or your own), agree the scores, then give every risk an owned, dated action - or a recorded reason to accept it. Everything here feeds the cockpit and the reports automatically.

Risks - add & complete the profile

Consultant judgement - the six HSG65 areas

Weak · Adequate · Strong - replaces the old maturity score

● Management system

Assess the client's health and safety management arrangements against the HSG65 plan, do, check, act cycle. For each duty: is it in place, is it adequate, and what action is needed where it falls short. The duty headings are seeded; add the requirement lines and references yourself.

● Review & feedback

A quality and progress picture for this client, with your rating tracked over time. Generate the Consultant Feedback report from the Reports tab.

Process assurance

Track the oversight carried out outside this app - site inspections, architectural reviews, CDM audits and other professional supervision, by you or an external party. Log what was planned, whether it happened, and the outcome. The result itself is filed manually; you may only know it was done, so note where the record lives.

Policy & procedure sign-off

Evidence that policies have been communicated to and understood by employees. Build the policy list (from Documents, the risk profile, or typed in), add your staff, print the acknowledgement sheets, then record who has signed for a live compliance picture.

● Document register

Key H&S documents for this client - policies, assessments, certificates, insurances. Links only (OneDrive / SharePoint); nothing is uploaded here. Each document's status is worked out from its review date. "Suggest from the app" lists what Compass already knows exists for this client - you complete the location and dates.

CPD library

The webinars, guides and short courses this client's people should work through, the monthly prompt that goes out to them, and the record you keep of both.

● Accreditation readiness

Common Assessment Standard (Build UK, Version 5). Summaries are our own wording plus question numbers, not the Build UK source text. Use this to see what each scheme needs and where the app already holds the evidence.

● Assurance records

Monthly capture, quarterly review
Pick a month and enter that month's figures below. The inspection scores fill in from your inspections, and the incident counts fill in from the incident register lower down. Save when you are done.

● Risk assessment register

A register of this client's risk assessments and RAMS, with where each PDF lives. The client's folder stays the master: drag the folder (or its files) below and the register indexes itself from the file names and dates - drag it again any time to refresh. Nothing is uploaded; the app records names, paths and dates only.
Drag the client's risk assessment folder (or files) here
…or click to choose files · re-dragging refreshes the index · PDF, Word and Excel files are read; other files are skipped

● Restore a previous version

The record as it stood before each save is kept on the server. If something is cleared by mistake, whether by a reset, an import that replaced the wrong section, or an edit that turned out to be wrong, put it back from here. Restoring is itself kept, so a restore to the wrong point can be undone as well.

● Offline copy access

The PC-held offline file cannot use your password (it has no server behind it). Generate a pairing token here, paste it into the offline copy once (Work offline → Connect to the live app), and that copy can then pull a client down before you go offline and push your work back when you return. Generating a new token revokes the old one; keep it private - it reads and writes client data.
